newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices remain mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady on Tuesday amid featureless activity as dealers watched the continued runup on the CBOT board.
Another dealer said he expected midds to rise along with the strong grain markets. "I'm not selling it cheap," he said.
By the way everything is going up, "it will absolutely murder business," a Texas dealer said.
But he said he anticipated a slowdown in business after next week. Higher grain prices will run the price of midds so high "they won't buy anything," he said.
The market was thin and there was not much of a change in demand. "This week, it was been pretty weak on flour mill run time," a Buffalo dealer said. Thus, he noted nearby supplies were tight.
"We are more at the mercy of (flour mill) running time and green grass than if corn goes up a nickel or down a nickel. In the short term, I don't think it matters," a Kansas dealer said.
